resources.string: Checks incoming messages for fraud right on your phone.
The app isn\'t allowed to show notifications — you won\'t see warnings.
So the phone doesn\'t stop checking in the background, let the app run without battery restrictions.
High — more warnings, more false alarms
Normal — catches ~93% of scams, ~1 false alarm per 100 ordinary messages
Only obvious — ~2 false alarms per 1000, but misses more
Other messengers (Viber, Instagram, Messenger, Signal, imo)
Hello, this is the Kaspi security service. There is a suspicious transfer on your card. Tell us the SMS code to cancel it.
🔒 The app has no internet access: message text is never sent anywhere, all checking happens on the phone. The warning list is stored only here and removed with “Clear list”.
Don\'t share SMS codes, passwords or card details, and don\'t open links. Call your bank on the number on the back of your card.
“Full analysis on the website” opens the project\'s website and sends it this text.
Thanks! Marked. Saved only on this phone.

Marks help improve the model. Messages marked \"not fraud\" get no more warnings; \"Clear marks\" brings them back. Before sending them to the team, replace names, phone and card numbers with [NAME], [PHONE], [CARD].
Marked as not fraud. No more warnings about this message.
